newsitem.title: USA: Cohr Inc names Chopra chairman of the board.
newsitem.headline: Cohr Inc names Chopra chairman of the board.

text.p: COHR Inc. said on Wednesday its board of directors elected President and Chief Executive Officer Paul Chopra to Chairman of the Board.

"In recognition of his consistently high level of performance, his leadership and his accomplishments as CEO, the board unanimously decided to elect Paul as chairman," said former Chairman Lynn P. Reitnouer.
Reitnouer, a partner with Crowell, Weedon & Co., remains on the board, which recognized him for his service as chairman during COHR's transition from private ownership to a public company.
COHR Inc. serves hospitals, integrated health systems and alternate site providers nationwide with a broad range of outsourced healthcare services and supplies.
